description: A script for managing sponsors on a website, including removing existing sponsors from markdown pages and adding new sponsors based on data fetched from a Google Sheets API.

methods.name: removeAllSponsors
methods.description: Removes sponsors from markdown files in specified directories by editing frontmatter.

methods.name: addPageSponsor
methods.description: Adds a sponsor entry to the frontmatter of a specific markdown page based on provided sponsor details.
